title: Centipede Polypeptide Affects the Inflammatory Reaction and Ferroptosis of Liver Cancer Cells Through the p53/TRAIL Pathway.
authors: Xing, Xingru; Lu, Linzhu; Huang, Zhen; Wang, Jiawei; Wang, Lihuai; Hu, Yuxing; Yin, Shan; Tian, Sha
journal: Journal of cellular and molecular medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蜈蚣多肽通过p53/TRAIL通路影响肝癌细胞炎症与铁死亡，仅用分子对接模拟CP与p53结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Various extracts from centipedes have therapeutic effects on liver cancer. This study aims to illustrate the impact and mechanism of centipede polypeptide (CP) on liver cancer. The suitable CP concentration and liver cancer cells were screened through CCK-8 analysis. The expression of proteins was analysed by Western blot. The level of cytokines and markers was measured by ELISA and biochemical kits. The apoptosis rate of cells was analysed by TUNEL staining and flow cytometry. Histopathological changes were observed by HE staining. The expression of Ki-67 and caspase-3 was assessed by IHC staining. The combination of CP and p53 was simulated by molecular docking. 200 mug/mL CP and HepG2 cells were applied in experiments. CP significantly upregulated p53, TNF-associated apoptosis-inducing ligand (TRAIL), TRADD and TRAF expression in HepG2 cells and tumour tissues (p < 0.05), suggesting p53-dependent activation of the TRAIL pathway. CP raised the levels of IL-6, IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, MDA and ROS, and decreased those of IL-10, TGF-beta1 and SOD in HepG2 cell supernatant and serum of nude mice (p < 0.05). CP promoted cell apoptosis and reduced the levels of ALT and AST to inhibit the progression of cancer. Molecular docking showed that CP could bind stably to p53 (p < 0.05). Silencing of p53 restrained the activation of the p53/TRAIL pathway and reduced the level of inflammatory reaction and ferroptosis, thus reversing the therapeutic effect of CP on liver cancer (p < 0.05). CP affected the inflammatory reaction and ferroptosis of liver cancer cells through the p53/TRAIL pathway.
abstract_zh: 蜈蚣的多种提取物对肝癌具有治疗作用。本研究旨在阐明蜈蚣多肽（CP）对肝癌的影响及其机制。通过CCK-8分析筛选合适的CP浓度和肝癌细胞。利用Western blot分析蛋白质表达。采用ELISA和生化试剂盒测定细胞因子和标志物水平。通过TUNEL染色和流式细胞术分析细胞凋亡率。通过HE染色观察组织病理学变化。通过IHC染色评估Ki-67和caspase-3的表达。通过分子对接模拟CP与p53的结合。实验中应用200 μg/mL CP和HepG2细胞。CP显著上调HepG2细胞和肿瘤组织中p53、TNF相关凋亡诱导配体（TRAIL）、TRADD和TRAF的表达（p < 0.05），提示p53依赖性激活TRAIL通路。CP提高了HepG2细胞上清液和裸鼠血清中IL-6、IL-1β、TNF-α、MDA和ROS的水平，并降低了IL-10、TGF-β1和SOD的水平（p < 0.05）。CP促进细胞凋亡，并降低ALT和AST水平以抑制癌症进展。分子对接显示CP能稳定结合p53（p < 0.05）。p53的沉默抑制了p53/TRAIL通路的激活，并降低了炎症反应和铁死亡水平，从而逆转了CP对肝癌的治疗效果（p < 0.05）。CP通过p53/TRAIL通路影响肝癌细胞的炎症反应和铁死亡。
